scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ../shared && tsc && npm run copy-soundfonts
scripts.copy-soundfonts: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('src','soundfonts');const dst=path.join('dist','soundfonts');fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dst,f));"
